question: Which 5 buyers have the highest average award amount per tender?
sql: SELECT b.buyer_name, AVG(a.amount_usd) AS avg_award_usd FROM tenders AS t JOIN buyers AS b ON b.buyer_id = t.buyer_id JOIN awards AS a ON a.tender_id = t.tender_id GROUP BY b.buyer_id, b.buyer_name ORDER BY avg_award_usd DESC LIMIT 5

question: ¿Cuál es el contrato de mayor monto por provincia de la entidad contratante?

gold_sql: WITH per_province AS (SELECT b.province, c.contract_id, c.amount_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.province ORDER BY c.amount_usd DESC, c.contract_id) AS rn FROM contracts c JOIN tenders t ON t.tender_id = c.tender_id JOIN buyers b ON b.buyer_id = t.buyer_id WHERE b.province IS NOT NULL AND c.amount_usd IS NOT NULL) SELECT province, contract_id, ROUND(amount_usd, 2) AS amount_usd FROM per_province WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY province
